turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hey, good to have you here. How are you?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: My friends want to start a weekly game night and asked me to pick what we play.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Let me lay out all the options first. Don't interrupt.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: A space survival game where we build a base together and try not to starve.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: There's a pirate game where we sail one ship and everybody has a job, steering, sails or cannons.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Or a quick card battler, very competitive, matches only take ten minutes.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Okay, that's all of them. What do you think?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: For a weekly night, I'd go with the pirate ship. Everyone has a role, and the funniest stories come out of it. The space base is great if your friends like planning, and the card game suits people who only drop in for a bit.
